ideas.pitch: An interactive desktop tool built to step through complex data structure operations and graph traversal algorithms line-by-line with real-time complexity analysis.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 & 2: Data Structures and Algorithms Problem-Solving and Efficiency.
ideas.title: AlgoVisualizer Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since judges in competitive programming evaluate correctness and efficiency, a tool that exposes the inner mechanics and performance bottlenecks of advanced algorithms directly targets their evaluation criteria.

ideas.pitch: A minimalist, low-latency live coding platform designed for individual contestants to practice head-to-head algorithmic problem-solving with automated test-case generation.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Programming Fundamentals and Algorithmic Challenge solving.
ideas.title: CP-Duel Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses intensely on speed, accuracy, and penalty reduction—the exact metrics specified for evaluating participants in the hackathon guidelines.

ideas.pitch: A specialized C-based CLI tool and library for solving heavy logical and mathematical problems with optimized bit manipulation shortcuts.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Logical & Mathematical Problems and Programming Fundamentals.
ideas.title: Bitwise Math Solver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates extreme execution speed and low-level optimization in C, mirroring projects that succeed through raw performance efficiency.

ideas.pitch: A local command-line judge utility that runs test suites against candidate solutions, measuring execution time, memory overhead, and corner-case failures instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Evaluation based on problems solved, correctness, efficiency, and time/penalty.
ideas.title: AutoJudge CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly automates the exact grading rubric judges use, showing deep understanding of time/penalty constraints in competitive programming.

ideas.pitch: An algorithmic sandbox specifically tuned for instant visualization and resolution of NP-hard graph and network flow problems under tight time limits.
ideas.title: GraphOpt Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to judges looking for advanced data structure handling and optimized algorithmic complexity rather than basic web wrappers.
